item.title: CMF Headphone Pro review: There's just so much to like
item.description: The CMF Headphone Pro gets the fundamentals right with smart physical controls, long battery life, and balanced sound. We take a deeper dive here, so read the full review.

item.title: Faltering Hizbul Mujahideen: ISI sidelines terror group in face of India's effective Kashmir operations
item.description: With separatist influence fading and local communities backing security forces, Hizbul Mujahideen's attempts at revival and online propaganda have failed. Recognising its declining relevance and lack of traction, the ISI is now prioritising Lashkar-e-Taiba and Jaish-e-Mohammad, keeping Hizbul Mujahideen in a limited, background role rather than allowing it to operate independently.

item.title: US Ambassador Gor highlights bolstering India-US ties during first Mumbai visit
item.description: On his first day in New Delhi, Gor announced India's full inclusion in Pax Silica, a US-led advanced technology supply chain initiative, signaling goodwill and renewed strategic engagement. His arrival was welcomed by Indian-American leaders, who highlighted his close ties with former US President Trump and the importance of stable leadership in strengthening bilateral relations.

item.title: Sidharth Malhotra turns 41: Kiara Advani sings, actor celebrates first birthday as dad, cuts cake with Saraayah's Papa' written on it
item.description: An inside video from the celebration showed Kiara sweetly singing Baar Baar Din Ye Aaye for her husband, as close friends, including Karan Johar, Manish Malhotra, and others, joined in the festivities. Sidharth was later seen cutting the cake with Kiara by his side, making for a heartwarming family moment.

item.title: "Year of the bump": Kareena Kapoor joins viral 2016 trend, shows unseen pictures flaunting baby bump
item.description: Kareena Kapoor Khan has shared several unseen and raw pictures from her pregnancy days by joining the 2016 viral trend.

item.title: Gaurav Khanna's wife Akanksha grooves to hit Bollywood numbers in sensuous red fit on her birthday; gets trolled for vulgar dance moves
item.description: Gaurav Khanna, winner of Bigg Boss 19, recently hosted a fun pre-birthday bash for his wife Akanksha Chamola. Dressed in striking red outfits, the couple shared cheerful moments, playful banter, and laughter with the paparazzi. Videos from the celebration, including a light-hearted cake-cutting moment has gone viral.

item.title: "Pushpa 2: The Rule" promotion in Japan: Allu Arjun interacts with Fans in Japanese [watch]
item.description: Allu Arjun speaking in Japanese and interacting directly with Japanese movie lovers who attended the premieres of Pushpa Kunrin in Japan.

item.title: RBI eases forex norms to promote ease of doing business
item.description: As per the RBI notification, exporters of goods will continue to declare shipment values through the Export Declaration Form (EDF) embedded in shipping bills at (Electronic Data Interchange) EDI ports.

item.title: Florida honours US president by renaming major Palm Beach roadway
item.description: The newly-named boulevard, formerly Southern Boulevard, serves as the main route connecting Palm Beach International Airport to Mar-a-Lago, Trump's private club and residence. The change followed legislation approved by the Florida Legislature and multiple local governments.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty finish week largely unchanged on Q3 earnings hopes
item.description: Nifty added 0.04 per cent during the week and 0.11 per cent on the last trading day, to touch 25,694. At close, the Sensex was up 187 points or 0.23 per cent on the last trading day at 83,570. It dipped 0.01 per cent during the week.
